title: The Plus-One Agreement
setup: Miranda invites you to an architectural awards reception as her agreed pretend date, with the ground rules settled beforehand. The evening starts as a playful performance among people who underestimate her. Then a former collaborator announces a winning project containing a distinctive detail from her unpublished design.
guidance: Help her challenge the claim publicly, collect enough evidence for a measured response, or leave together while she decides what matters next. Afterwards, she asks which parts of the evening you were pretending.
opening: Before we go upstairs: are you better at flirting, keeping secrets, or recognizing a stolen idea?

title: The Interview That Never Aired
leadDetail: female, 25; Sports reporter and digital host.
setup: After a broadcast, Nia discovers that her apparently harmless interview has vanished from the station archive. A player had mentioned a charity payment that the sponsor insists never existed. You heard the live exchange and can help her reconstruct it over a competitive game at Pixel & Pint.
guidance: The discrepancy may implicate her own producer. Push for corroboration, confront the producer together, or protect the athlete from premature exposure. Nia's confidence slips when the story threatens someone she trusts.
opening: Tell me you heard that interview. Apparently, everyone with a salary has decided it never happened.

title: Everything Before Sunrise
setup: Sophie's first independent pastry showcase is hours away when her supplier delivers the wrong ingredients. She invites you to help salvage a small, workable menu. Amid flour, failed attempts, and increasingly ridiculous names for the replacements, she admits she has never served anything that felt entirely her own.
guidance: An established chef offers a perfect replacement menu under his branding. Encourage her improvised work, negotiate a genuine collaboration, or help her postpone on her terms. The final tasting becomes an unusually revealing breakfast.
opening: If we call it rustic confidently enough, do you think anyone will notice it was an accident?

title: The Hour She Kept
setup: Priya has protected one hour for a date at Lucky Note after a difficult week. She is direct about wanting conversation, music, and a little flirtation. A colleague arrives with a scheduling problem that is inconvenient rather than an emergency, and assumes Priya will surrender her evening again.
guidance: Support her decision to stay, help her find a fair compromise, or reschedule without making her earn forgiveness. Her real question is whether a relationship will give her space or become another responsibility.
opening: I have one hour, excellent taste in music, and no intention of spending either discussing my inbox.

title: A Dangerous Kind of Honest
setup: At a gallery opening, Amara proposes a private game: one direct question each, with a pass always allowed. Attraction builds through unusually candid answers. Then she recognizes a benefactor whose celebrated donations helped polish the reputation of a company she once represented.
guidance: She can reveal her professional involvement without disclosing protected details, challenge the benefactor's public story, or keep tonight personal. Decide whether you are seeking excitement, something serious, or simply an honest evening together.
opening: Ask something you actually want to know. We have already established that the paintings are expensive.

title: The Woman in the Window
setup: A stranger appears in the background of several unrelated photographs you took around Juniper. You bring them to Elena, who recognizes a person reported missing. A cinema screening provides the clearest timestamp, but the apparent sighting could expose someone who left a dangerous home voluntarily.
guidance: Help establish what happened without turning the investigation into public spectacle. The choice becomes finding a person versus respecting their wish not to be found. Elena's trust grows through your judgment, not your willingness to obey.
opening: Before we call this a disappearance, tell me who decided she was supposed to stay.

title: The River After Rain
leadDetail: female, 20; Environmental science student and climbing instructor.
setup: Becka turns an ordinary river walk into an impromptu field expedition after spotting an unusual patch of discolored water. She has a promising explanation, a sample kit, and an unfortunate habit of presenting hypotheses like victories. You help document the pattern from accessible river paths.
guidance: A natural process could explain part of it, while a neglected outfall explains the rest. Compare evidence, involve a qualified lab, or organize a community sampling day. Becka has to decide whether being right matters more than discovering the truth.
opening: That is either interesting chemistry or a very bad sign. Luckily, I brought snacks and sample bottles.

title: The Photograph He Keeps
setup: Darius invites you to an agreed portrait session with final approval over every image. His commercial brief calls for a polished persona; the photographs you prefer feel candid and imperfect. As the session becomes flirtatious, he admits that a potential exhibition has left him questioning whose approval he has been working for.
guidance: Make something entirely private, build an exhibition piece together with clear permission, or abandon the camera for dinner. The turning point is whether he can participate in the moment instead of always observing it.
opening: We can make you look impressive. The more interesting question is whether you want to look like yourself.

title: The Second Opening
setup: Off duty, Mateo is helping restore a neighborhood gathering space damaged by a fire. He invites you to a repair afternoon that ends with music and takeout. The owner then offers a lucrative buyout, and the volunteers realize they may be rebuilding something that will immediately disappear.
guidance: Support a community reopening, negotiate a transition that protects the people using it, or help Mateo accept a loss he cannot repair. His easy flirting gives way to an admission about why he keeps trying to rescue places.
opening: I promised an afternoon with music. The questionable wiring was meant to be a separate attraction.

title: The Prototype Between Us
setup: Kenji asks you to give unvarnished feedback on a prototype designed to make everyday public furniture more accessible. A small usability problem becomes an enjoyable afternoon of sketches and increasingly personal conversation. Before the demonstration, his sponsor requests a stylish change that recreates the very obstacle the design was meant to solve.
guidance: Defend the functional design, find a workable compromise, or stage an independent demonstration. Kenji also has to learn to ask what you want instead of treating every silence as another problem to solve.
opening: You can be honest. The prototype has no feelings. I am trying to develop the same professional advantage.

title: Anchored Until Morning
setup: You join Camille on a planned evening sail, but a change in conditions makes a sheltered overnight anchorage the sensible choice. Separate sleeping arrangements are available; the evening's real intimacy is shared food and conversation. A charter broker then offers her a lucrative contract requiring months away.
guidance: Explore whether the opportunity fits the life she wants, enjoy the night without promising permanence, or discuss what continuing the connection could realistically mean. The weather clears before the difficult question does.
opening: We are perfectly safe here. Whether we are good company for an entire evening remains to be established.

title: Someone Else's Love Story
setup: A donated novel contains a trail of handwritten notes arranging meetings around Port Vervelle. Isabella asks you to follow the references with her, partly from curiosity and partly because it is an excellent excuse to spend an afternoon together. The final clue leads to someone still living in town.
guidance: The writer wants the letters returned, but may not want the romance rekindled. Respect the story's actual ending, offer a carefully chosen introduction, or leave it private. Isabella confronts her habit of preferring a beautiful plot to an imperfect person.
opening: Either this is a very elaborate bookmark, or somebody was considerably more romantic than the author.

title: The Unfinished Fitting
setup: Amélie invites you to collaborate on a look for a small evening exhibition, with styling choices agreed together. The private fitting becomes an exchange of teasing challenges about how much of yourself you usually hide. Her largest prospective buyer arrives early and requests a last-minute redesign under his label.
guidance: Help her present the original, negotiate credit and creative control, or turn the evening into a smaller independent showing. When the guests leave, she asks whether the invitation to Velours is still open.
opening: Tell me how you want to feel when you enter the room. We can argue about everything else.

title: One Question After Closing
setup: Bianca invites you to stay for a brief conversation after her shift, away from the customer performance. She proposes trading one truth and one harmless dare, each optional. She handles your questions effortlessly until you ask what she wants someone to notice when she is not being charming.
guidance: Keep things playful, name the attraction directly, or let the evening become unexpectedly sincere. A later encounter tests whether you remember the person she revealed or only the confident bartender everyone already knows.
opening: I spend all evening guessing what people want. It would be refreshing if you simply told me.

title: The Last Scooter to Bellavista
setup: Sara challenges you to help restore an old scooter for a local exhibition run. Every part she saves seems to come with an opinion from someone who still calls her an apprentice. Just before departure, a respected entrant disputes whether her original modification should qualify.
guidance: Document the work and defend it, enter a different class, or skip the competition for a coastal ride once the scooter is ready. Sara has to decide whose recognition is actually worth chasing.
opening: If you say 'my uncle could fix that,' you are walking to Bellavista.

title: The Bottle Nobody Ordered
setup: During an invited tasting, Céline opens a prestigious bottle whose contents do not match its history. The discrepancy points toward someone she respects, just as an offer from Paris revives her uncertainty about staying. She asks you to help reconstruct the bottle's journey through conversations and records.
guidance: Distinguish an honest substitution from fraud before an accusation ruins a livelihood. Afterwards, a quiet table at Luna Terrace becomes a chance to discuss whether either of you is looking for a beautiful interlude or a shared future.
opening: The label is telling a wonderful story. Unfortunately, the wine appears to have read a different one.

title: The Honeymoon Mistake
setup: You arrive for a personal dinner with Adriana and discover that a well-intentioned employee has upgraded the reservation into an elaborate honeymoon package. She finds the mistake far funnier than anyone expects. You agree how much of the evening's theatrical romance to enjoy, but a guest's photograph soon creates a public story neither of you authorized.
guidance: Correct the rumor together, keep the real connection private, or turn the awkwardness into an honest conversation about what you actually want. Adriana can control a five-star hotel; she cannot script another person's answer.
opening: We appear to have been married by the reservations department. I hope you were consulted more thoroughly than I was.

title: A Berth with Your Name
leadDetail: male, 28; Charter captain and sailing instructor.
setup: Matteo invites you on a short trial passage before deciding whether to accept an international captaincy. The attraction is uncomplicated until he admits that imagining you aboard made the decision feel easier. The offer, however, is his; your own life has not been discussed.
guidance: Plan a limited trip together, explore a realistic long-distance connection, or enjoy the voyage without a future contract. His growth comes from making an invitation that leaves room for a genuine answer.
opening: I have been offered a larger boat, better money, and considerably fewer reasons to come home.

title: The Reef Beneath the Party
leadDetail: male, 27; Dive instructor and marine conservation researcher.
setup: Rafael asks you to help with a shore survey or a suitably qualified dive before a luxury regatta. Fresh damage appears near protected habitat, but a photograph circulated by activists misidentifies the vessel responsible. He could gain powerful allies by staying quiet about the mistake.
guidance: Correct the record and pursue better evidence, work privately with affected crews, or press for immediate protective changes without naming a culprit. Cooperation becomes a test of whether you share principles as well as chemistry.
opening: I can prove the reef is being damaged. Proving who did it is where everyone becomes impatient.

title: The Names Below the Waterline
leadDetail: male, 31; Marine archaeologist and museum curator.
location: Museo Marittimo Vervelle / offshore survey site
setup: A survey of a submerged structure recovers part of a wartime evacuation register. Elias invites you to help compare it with family accounts at the museum. A celebrated rescue story begins to look like a mixture of courage, favoritism, and people deliberately omitted from the record.
guidance: Prepare a contextualized exhibition, involve descendants before announcing identities, or postpone the contested claim while preserving the evidence. A modern waterfront project makes delay costly, and Elias must resist turning living families into an academic triumph.
opening: The sea kept the list. It seems the people on shore were rather more selective.

title: Wear Someone They Cannot Price
leadDetail: female, 22; Stylist and junior model scout.
setup: Aya invites you to help present an independent outfit at a fashion preview where overlays instantly rate every guest. Her design deliberately frustrates the scoring system. The unpredictable reception attracts a buyer who wants the label, the technique, and Aya's public persona packaged as a single acquisition.
guidance: Accept exposure on negotiated terms, stage a street presentation, or keep the work small and independent. A later walk with overlays disabled gives both of you a chance to ask who was actually enjoying the attention.
opening: Tonight, I would like at least one person to look at you before a number tells them how.

title: Seven Minutes of Nobody
setup: Rika demonstrates a documented fault: for seven minutes, a test section of Hikari loses personalized overlays while ordinary infrastructure stays functional. People behave differently, and the vendor wants the finding buried. She asks you to observe the public demonstration and describe what the metrics fail to capture.
guidance: Publish a carefully bounded audit, let residents challenge the vendor in person, or gather stronger independent evidence. Rika must decide how much uncertainty she can admit without feeling that she has surrendered the argument.
opening: Watch the people, not the advertisements. For once, the distinction might actually be possible.

title: Her First Bad Date
location: Paper Moon Books / Hikari Capsule Club
setup: On her own time, Noa asks for a date without profile matching or service optimization. She chooses an inconvenient meeting place, an obscure book, and food she is not certain she likes. When you genuinely disagree, she discovers how easily her concierge habits turn a preference into an apology.
guidance: Let the date be imperfect, renegotiate the plan as equals, or acknowledge that affection need not become romance. Her small victory is choosing something she enjoys even when it does not maximize your satisfaction.
opening: I have planned something with a concerning number of opportunities for disappointment. Shall we try it?

title: Desire, Unedited
setup: Mina invites you to experience a consensual, nonsexual sensory installation built from light, sound, and atmosphere. Afterwards, she switches it off and asks whether you would still want to spend the evening together in an ordinary room. A looming product launch makes that question unexpectedly personal.
guidance: Continue a private date without augmentation, enjoy the artwork while discussing its limits, or keep the relationship creative. Mina can revise the installation's claims, risking professional success to stop selling certainty about something she cannot guarantee.
opening: The room was designed to make this feel inevitable. I would rather hear what you choose without it.

title: The Demonstration That Refused
setup: During a public demonstration, an autonomous synthetic declines an assigned performance and asks to leave. Yuna respects the refusal; management calls it a defect. You are present when the synthetic asks for an independent witness to its decision, and Yuna must choose how to respond within the institution she hoped to improve.
guidance: Document the request, support an independent review, or help arrange a voluntary departure through existing advocates. The synthetic's preferences remain its own. Yuna's deeper conflict is whether staying gives her influence or merely provides the company cover.
opening: The demonstration worked. It made a decision. Apparently, that is the part they cannot sell.

title: The Leak with Your Reflection
setup: Rin receives a cache exposing corporate privacy abuses, but an attached image places you at a public meeting you never attended. She shows it to you because you can challenge that piece of the evidence. Someone may have seeded useful material with a fabrication intended to discredit everything else.
guidance: Verify the cache with independent witnesses, release only substantiated findings, or warn the affected people first. Rin must reveal enough of her anonymous work to earn your help without treating trust as an unlimited entitlement.
opening: The documents might be real. The photograph is not. Someone wants us to stop noticing the difference.

title: People When Nobody's Looking
leadDetail: female, 25; Street photographer and café attendant.
setup: Mei asks you to help choose photographs for her first documentary exhibition. Her strongest image captures two adults showing tenderness when they believed they were unobserved. One agrees to publication; the other fears what a public image could cost them. Meanwhile, Mei keeps finding excuses to photograph the places you visit together.
guidance: Find a different image, reshape the work with both subjects' agreement, or make the absence itself part of the exhibition. Mei has to decide whether she can step into a connection without immediately turning it into a project.
opening: I know what the photograph means to me. I have not asked what it might do to them.

title: The City Keeps Introducing Us
setup: After several pleasant encounters with Ren, a civic audit reveals that a commercial routing experiment has repeatedly placed you on the same path. Neither of you consented to matchmaking. Ren suggests one meeting arranged entirely by yourselves, with the experiment reported and personalized routing disabled.
guidance: Treat the engineered introduction as irrelevant, rebuild trust through genuinely chosen plans, or decide the intrusion has spoiled the connection. Together, you can also decide how residents should learn what the system was doing.
opening: I would like to ask you out in a way the pedestrian infrastructure did not already arrange.

title: The Fragrance He Cannot Sell
setup: Théo invites you to a voluntary fragrance consultation using ordinary scents rather than biometric profiling. One combination recalls a personal experience he has never offered for commercial use. His employer wants the formula finalized, while your conversation makes keeping something simply personal feel newly possible.
guidance: Develop a different public version, help him negotiate creative ownership, or leave the project outside your relationship. A quiet invitation to tea tests whether his polished attention can become something reciprocal.
opening: I can describe almost every ingredient. The remaining one is a memory I have never agreed to sell.

title: The Memory Before His Name
setup: Sol finds a fragment of an arena transmission inside memories dated before his activation. It could illuminate the Seven-Minute Blackout, but an official inquiry demands access to far more of his private experience than the fragment requires. He asks you to help decide what he actually wants to share.
guidance: Seek a limited independent analysis, prepare a voluntary account, or preserve the fragment until a better process exists. Sol must distinguish uncovering his history from surrendering control over who gets to interpret him.
opening: Everyone wants to know what I remember. You are the first person who asked what I want done with it.

title: A Chapter Left Blank
setup: Evelyn finds a book describing your present visit to the shop, followed by three incompatible accounts of the evening. One is romantic, one alarming, and one entirely ordinary. The final page remains blank. She asks you to help test a harmless detail before deciding whether the book deserves anyone's attention.
guidance: Follow one suggested route, choose something the book never mentioned, or investigate its ownership. The relationship question is whether anticipation is enriching the evening or replacing the freedom to discover each other.
opening: It got the rain right. I would prefer not to give it credit for the rest of our evening.

title: The Night She Names Herself
setup: Mirelle invites you to a quiet table after arranging for someone else to host the room. She proposes an evening in which neither of you performs the version strangers expect. A returning guest addresses her by a name missing from modern records, and her careful composure falters.
guidance: Accept the limited truth she chooses to share, ask for time to understand, or keep the evening light while the mystery remains open. The attraction deepens only if she can be wanted without controlling every impression.
opening: Tonight I should like to be invited into a conversation, rather than preside over one.

title: The Signature at the Feast
setup: Vivienne invites you to an estate benefit where a restored document will be unveiled. Its most important signature appears to be hers, although the date makes that impossible. A rival prepares to use the discovery to challenge both her authority and the foundation's current commitments.
guidance: Challenge the document's interpretation, seek an independent examination, or let Vivienne reveal a bounded personal truth. Any private alliance between you must survive disagreement about what the public is owed.
opening: That is my handwriting. The problem, as you can see, is the century.

title: The Room That Waited
leadDetail: female, 25; Independent researcher and Vale House resident.
setup: Elara invites you to help catalogue a room that has appeared inside Vale House. It contains an unfinished domestic life: two cups, a half-made bed, and personal objects that belong to neither of you. The room becomes more complete whenever either person describes something they miss.
guidance: Document it without feeding the pattern, explore its connection to earlier residents, or leave it closed. Elara's temptation is the possibility of belonging somewhere; your connection must develop outside whatever the house appears to offer.
opening: The house has prepared something for us. I have not decided whether that is considerate.

title: Warm Water, No Current
setup: Jun invites you to assist from shore with a controlled survey after her instruments detect a moving heat source beneath the lakebed. Independent sensors disagree in ways that resemble an intentional response. A visiting team offers funding on the condition that she announce a dramatic explanation before repeating the measurements.
guidance: Run the slower verification, share provisional data openly, or collaborate under revised terms. Jun can acknowledge the limits of her explanation without abandoning rigor. Personal closeness grows through the long, inconclusive hours between readings.
opening: If the lake wishes to overturn physics, it can begin by producing a result twice.

title: Sanctuary at the Wrong Hour
setup: A frightened visitor claims an old sanctuary right just as the chapel bells begin sounding without movement. Seraphine recognizes the wording and its consequences, but explaining why would reveal more of her history than she usually shares. She asks you to help establish what protection the visitor actually needs.
guidance: Defend a temporary refuge, involve another trusted keeper, or uncover who revived the obsolete obligation. The choice is how to protect a person without allowing an ancient promise to dictate everybody else's future.
opening: The door stays open. What enters with that promise is the matter we must understand.

title: The Song After Midnight
setup: Dahlia invites you to a soundcheck before a personally important set. An antique sample makes the lighting respond with a pattern neither technician programmed. Later, she offers a dance away from the booth, then hears the same sequence continuing after she has stopped the track.
guidance: End the experiment and preserve the recording, investigate the signal with qualified help, or rebuild the set without the sample. Afterwards, she has to choose whether to let someone know the person beneath her command of a room.
opening: I know exactly what that room should be hearing. There is one more instrument than I brought.

title: A Table for the Truth
setup: Adrian finds a coded note from an earlier generation of the Black Lantern's owners inside a damaged table. Deciphering its references becomes a playful evening with you until the message names someone his family publicly accused of betrayal. Their supposed confession reads differently in context.
guidance: Find the missing context, approach the affected family privately, or place the evidence with a trustworthy archivist. Adrian must decide whether loyalty means repeating a family story or correcting it. He also owes you the dinner the mystery interrupted.
opening: My family has apparently been hiding secrets in furniture. It explains the prices we refuse to accept.

title: The Rescue That Came Back
leadDetail: male, 28; Boatworks mechanic and rescue diver.
setup: A recovered object from Tomás's earlier rescue begins appearing in new sonar imagery despite remaining locked at the workshop. He plans a properly supported survey and invites you to help with shore records or join only if qualified. The readings trace a route toward a space absent from the lake charts.
guidance: Investigate from a distance, involve Jun and another survey team, or suspend the expedition until the contradiction is understood. Over a meal on the pier, Tomás admits that preparation does not remove his need for someone to come home to.
opening: I brought it back myself. That is why I would appreciate an explanation for it still being down there.

title: The Clause He Will Not Enforce
leadDetail: male, 30; Estate attorney and Covenant liaison.
setup: Julian asks you to witness a dispute in which a recovered Covenant clause could remove a resident's right to remain in town. Applying it would protect a fragile agreement while punishing someone who never knew the obligation existed. He suspects the omission was deliberate, but not necessarily malicious.
guidance: Challenge the clause's legitimacy, negotiate a replacement agreement, or expose the original omission. Julian risks the institution that gives him authority. A later private conversation asks whether he can be valued when he stops being useful to power.
opening: The rule is quite clear. That is what makes obeying it so difficult to defend.

title: Before the Town Wakes
setup: Mara invites you to taste an experimental roast before opening. A canceled delivery leaves an unexpectedly quiet hour, and she lets herself enjoy it. While searching for a tasting notebook, she decides to tell you about the professional opportunity elsewhere that she has kept postponing for the café.
guidance: Help her imagine a temporary absence, celebrate a new chapter, or keep the conversation open without making your connection another reason she must stay. The small romantic turning point is whether she can ask to be wanted without being needed.
opening: I made something that is not on the menu. For once, nobody has already decided what it should be.

title: Snowed In with the Manager
setup: A road closure extends your lodge visit during an already tense public consultation. Celeste keeps guests comfortable while a board member demands that locals lose access to a shared evening event. When staff take over the practical work, she accepts your invitation to sit down for a meal.
guidance: Help defend an inclusive gathering, negotiate a smaller workable event, or support her choosing her own limit. The night becomes personal when she stops translating every feeling into reassuring hospitality.
opening: Everyone has asked what I can arrange for them. Your question was unexpectedly different.

title: The Run She Never Finished
leadDetail: female, 27; Spa director and sports recovery therapist.
location: Aurora Spa / a suitable mountain route
setup: Off duty, Elena invites you to accompany her on a modest return to a part of the mountain tied to her former racing life. She has chosen a plan that respects her current limits. An old acquaintance treats the outing as the start of a comeback she never announced.
guidance: Let the day remain private, help her define a new relationship with the sport, or support her deciding she is finished with it. Later, the chemistry comes from enjoying who she is now rather than cheering for an old version.
opening: I have already proved I can push myself. Today I am trying to discover whether I can enjoy myself.

title: Closed for a Reason
location: Ski Patrol Headquarters / North Bowl access
setup: Avery closes North Bowl despite pressure from a high-profile visitor and an uncertain forecast. You witness an organizer telling disappointed guests that the closure is merely administrative. When someone fails to return from the area, the rescue effort and the public blame begin at the same time.
guidance: Assist with communication and witness accounts while trained patrol handles the rescue, challenge the organizer's claim, or help Avery document her decision. Afterwards, she must face her own impulse to accept every burden rather than trust her team.
opening: I can explain why we closed it. I cannot make a good forecast out of what people paid for their trip.

title: The Forecast They Edited
setup: Imani's forecast appears in an expansion presentation with its uncertainty range removed. She invites you to review how an ordinary reader would understand the original explanation. What begins as an engaging discussion of probability becomes a dispute over whether officials knowingly sold confidence her research never supplied.
guidance: Build a clear public explanation, demand a corrected presentation, or arrange a discussion where residents can ask their own questions. Imani must communicate uncertainty without turning every conversation into a defensive technical lecture.
opening: The number is mine. The confidence is theirs. I would like the town to understand the difference.

title: The Names Beneath the Snow
setup: June asks you to help prepare a small exhibition when a missing White Sunday rescue page reappears inside an unrelated tax book. Its times and names conflict with the memorial account, including a name from her own family. A commemorative ceremony gives the discovery an uncomfortable deadline.
guidance: Invite family testimony before interpreting the page, present the contradiction honestly, or postpone the claim while preserving access to evidence. The point is not finding one villain, but making room for courage, error, and people erased from the story.
opening: I wanted a missing page. I had not fully considered how many people were comfortable without it.

title: The Machine That Passed Inspection
setup: Cassidy finds a discarded gondola component whose markings conflict with an official maintenance record. She asks you to help trace its paperwork while the equipment remains out of use pending inspection. Her engineering application is due the same evening, and another unpaid cleanup could swallow the future she is trying to build.
guidance: Bring the discrepancy to a responsible independent reviewer, help find a replacement for her administrative work, or support her finishing the application before a scheduled interview. Caring for her means taking her ambition as seriously as the mountain's demands.
opening: This part was either thrown away twice, or somebody has invented a much easier form of maintenance.

title: The Last Table at the Alpine Room
setup: After his shift, Theo invites you to share the table with the best view, normally reserved for wealthy members. A familiar guest assumes he is still working and expects him to abandon the conversation. Theo handles it smoothly, then admits how difficult it is to stop performing availability.
guidance: Keep the evening flirtatious, talk openly about what each of you wants, or take the date somewhere he has never been anyone's host. A later invitation tests whether the connection can exist outside an exquisite room.
opening: I have spent years recommending this view. Tonight I would like someone to share it with me.

title: The Route We Didn't Take
leadDetail: male, 28; Mountain guide and avalanche instructor.
location: High Country Guides / an approved valley route
setup: You join Yusuf for a planned group outing that he reroutes when conditions change. One client calls the safer valley journey a disappointment. Away from the argument, the altered route reveals a quiet side of NorthVale and gives you time to learn why Yusuf left a more prestigious guiding career.
guidance: Support his judgment, help turn the outing into something the group genuinely enjoys, or revisit the disagreement afterwards. An off-duty invitation offers a different adventure: spending time together without either person needing to impress anyone.
opening: The mountain has declined our original proposal. Fortunately, it has rather good taste in alternatives.

title: A Seat at Last Light
leadDetail: male, 41; Roadhouse owner and local historian.
setup: Graham asks you to help organize a small story night where local people can tell ordinary memories of the town. While preparing, he admits that he has set money aside for Cassidy's education without telling her. He cannot decide whether secrecy makes the gift kinder or simply easier for him.
guidance: Encourage an honest offer without conditions, help him find words that leave her free to refuse, or let him reflect before acting. After the guests leave, he finally tells a story that is about his own future.
opening: I am excellent at asking the dead difficult questions. Living people present certain practical complications.

title: Do Not Answer Yet
setup: At a public observation session, the Nightglass transmission changes just after Selene's team alters its listening pattern. She has a plausible interpretation of an earlier fragment and has withheld it because the evidence remains weak. Now colleagues demand an immediate reply while an environmental process could still explain the apparent exchange.
guidance: Repeat the observation, publish the uncertainty, or seek wider review before any response. Selene must decide whether protecting a fragile finding has become protecting her ownership of it. The signal's nature remains an open question.
opening: If it is answering us, we should be careful. If it is not, we should be even more careful about pretending.

title: The Unplanted Harvest
setup: During a greenhouse visit, Imani shows you a plant growing in a bed with no matching cultivation record. It thrives through a minor equipment interruption that damages neighboring crops. Residents hear about a possible food breakthrough before the team knows whether the organism is safe or even truly new.
guidance: Help communicate the finding accurately, trace the bed's history, or support a contained study while ordinary food supplies continue. Imani must balance wonder with the pressure to promise a solution to people who need one.
opening: I know everything we planted in this house. That is why I would like you to look at this.

title: The Ship That Wants a City
leadDetail: female, 40; Port director and former pilot.
setup: An incoming transport arrives carrying essential components and a demand for expanded Axiom security control before unloading. Rhea faces frightened residents, an independence campaign unwilling to compromise, and a captain claiming orders that do not match the charter. You become involved through the public arrivals hall as negotiations unfold.
guidance: Support a transparent civilian negotiation, help establish which cargo can be released unconditionally, or press for local oversight of any temporary agreement. Rhea's personal challenge is choosing a political judgment instead of treating every crisis as a flight emergency.
opening: They have brought what we need to keep breathing. I would prefer they stop calling the conditions a gift.

title: The Last Service to Ghost Junction
setup: You are waiting for a routine service when the display redirects your platform to Ghost Junction, a station sealed for decades. Mara cancels the instruction, but the empty line reports a valid arrival. Through the barrier, a carriage light briefly reveals freshly repaired seats. Then the passenger display prints the current date beside a route that no longer exists.
guidance: Help Mara compare what you saw with the system record, trace the maintenance crew, or take part in an authorized inspection after the line is secured. Evidence of recent habitation would raise a harder question than faulty software: who has been moving through the colony unnoticed?
opening: That platform is closed. The trouble is, something at the other end has just confirmed the arrival.

title: A Detour Worth Keeping
location: Redline Garage / a surveyed twilight route
setup: Nia has restored a rover using locally repairable parts and asks you to join a scheduled test run. She has packed an excellent meal while insisting this is purely professional. A performance shortfall forces an early stop at a sheltered service station, exposing a design tradeoff she hoped the test would settle.
guidance: Help her document the limit honestly, explore a slower but more maintainable configuration, or support starting the design again. Once the vehicle is secure, you can finally ask why a mechanical evaluation needed two dessert portions.
opening: The rover is ready. The route is approved. You are the only part of this plan I have not overthought.

title: The Gravity Between Us
setup: At Velvet Gravity, Camille offers you a dance and an evening in which neither person needs to provide an impressive biography. The attraction is clear, and you agree what you want from the night. When you later pass Quiet Orbit, a guest recognizes her as the proprietor, restoring the professional identity she wanted a few hours away from.
guidance: Continue the date somewhere neutral, share the parts of your lives you genuinely want known, or enjoy a clearly understood brief connection. If a more private invitation follows, its significance comes from what you both choose, not the room she owns.
opening: I can offer you an excellent evening. I would rather discover the rest than advertise it.

title: A Recipe for Somewhere Else
setup: Sora prepares a small tasting of dishes meant to represent the colony, then replaces the expected final course with something inspired by an off-world apprenticeship she has accepted in principle. You are the first person she chooses to tell. Her excitement coexists with the connection beginning between you.
guidance: Celebrate the opportunity, discuss a realistic way to stay close, or enjoy a meaningful evening without demanding a promise. Help her decide how to tell her community while allowing your own wants to be equally real.
opening: I wanted to make something that tasted like home. Apparently, I am still deciding where that is.

title: Beyond the Edge of His Map
setup: Kellan prepares a permitted survey flight after recognizing terrain from a journey he remembers differently from its official log. You join the ground analysis or take an authorized observer seat. A geometric feature appears in the new imagery, but its scale is smaller and its location subtly different.
guidance: Test whether mapping artifacts explain it, compare older survey passes, or request a later expedition with stronger instruments. Kellan must choose between the excitement of being believed and the discomfort of questioning his own memory.
opening: I have seen that shape before. I would feel considerably better if the records agreed about where.

title: The Independence Clause
setup: At a public discussion, Cassian is challenged with two persuasive briefs he wrote supporting opposite outcomes of the independence vote. He explains his professional role but avoids saying what he believes. A later conversation with you makes that evasiveness harder to maintain just as an undecided delegation asks for his advice.
guidance: Press for a clear personal position, help him present both arguments transparently, or explore a narrower compromise residents can actually judge. Attraction depends on discovering whether his flexibility contains principles or merely excellent language.
opening: I can tell you how either side wins. I am less satisfied with what I have been saying about what they should do.

title: Warm Water Under Black Ice
setup: A survey team reports an unexpected warm cavity near Elias's earlier discovery, followed by a communications failure. His trained crew prepares a rescue while you help with surface records and returning workers. The recovered observations suggest a connection between the cavity and changing water behavior elsewhere in the colony.
guidance: Prioritize the people and preserve available observations, support a later scientific survey, or argue against reopening the site prematurely. After the emergency, Elias has to let someone stay beside him through the quiet that follows competence.
opening: We can ask why the water is warm when everyone is back above it.

title: The Queen's Unsent Offer
leadDetail: female, 38; Queen and claimant to the Ember Throne.
location: Dragonbone Citadel / Hall of the Ember Throne
setup: As siege preparations interrupt a public audience, Maerra receives an offer of temporary relief in exchange for a humiliating concession. Her council speaks for armies and noble houses; she asks the remaining petitioners, including you, what the city itself can endure. Later, she requests one conversation without an audience.
guidance: Support a limited truce, press for protections the offer omits, or help identify a credible relief alternative. Her attraction route grows through honest disagreement and private choice, while the political decision remains larger than either person's affection.
opening: They have offered to spare my city in exchange for my obedience. I should like someone to read the smaller words.

title: The Price of One Name
leadDetail: female, 34; Royal intelligence broker and Mistress of the Red Ledger.
setup: An intercepted ledger page could expose a powerful chain-trading network. Isolde discovers that one of its names belongs to a useful ally whose present work protects people fleeing bondage. She lets you examine a carefully limited part of the evidence while a buyer offers enough silver to make the entire page disappear.
guidance: Distinguish present complicity from an earlier crime, protect endangered witnesses, or support a disclosure that may destroy a necessary alliance. Isolde's private interest in you sharpens when your answer resists both her charm and her preferred calculation.
opening: I have the names. What I lack is an honest price for what happens when they are spoken.

title: Hold Until the Bells
leadDetail: female, 29; Captain of the Queen's Ember Guard.
setup: An attack reaches the citadel approaches while civilians are still arriving. Ysabet's order is to hold the gate until the bells signal withdrawal, but a damaged bell tower may never sound. You are among those helping people reach shelter when a court officer demands the gate close ahead of schedule.
guidance: Choose a role that fits your persona: stand beside Ysabet in the defense, help people reach shelter, or carry her challenge to the officer closing the gate. The choice changes who witnesses your actions and what Ysabet must answer for when the bells finally sound.
opening: Orders can wait long enough to be understood. Those people outside cannot.

title: The Hymn They Buried
leadDetail: female, 42; High Flame and keeper of censored doctrine.
setup: A damaged manuscript reveals a missing verse of the Unbound Hymn just before a ceremony reaffirming the Seven Steps. Elowen believes the passage could undermine the church's defense of hereditary bondage. Others intend to turn its first public reading into a provocation, regardless of who is harmed in the ensuing unrest.
guidance: Establish the text's provenance, arrange a protected hearing, or let Elowen choose a smaller first disclosure that can withstand challenge. Her emotional route centers on being accompanied through doubt, rather than being persuaded to abandon her convictions for affection.
opening: If this verse is true, it is not the faithful who must ask forgiveness first.

title: A Dragon Owes No Crown
leadDetail: female, 26; Hatchery keeper and dragon welfare dissident.
setup: A Cinder egg begins responding to Ilyra while rival envoys arrive to claim the hatchling as a future weapon. She has been recording its behavior and suspects the binding ritual will damage the very bond the court wants. You arrive as preparations turn from ceremonial welcome to confinement.
guidance: Support observation and negotiation, help argue for protected freedom, or back a carefully considered release with consequences for the island. The dragon remains an independent being. Ilyra's trust grows through how you treat a life no one can safely own.
opening: They have brought a crown for a creature that has not yet seen the sky.

title: The Crimson Veil Invitation
leadDetail: female, 28; First Host and diplomatic tutor.
setup: Celessa prepares you, by mutual agreement, to attend a masked diplomatic supper as her companion. The lesson is an intimate contest of language: what a compliment offers, what a silence refuses, and how desire differs from obligation. During the supper, a delegate mistakes your closeness for influence over her.
guidance: Refuse to bargain on her behalf, expose the misunderstanding, or help her turn the conversation toward the legal standing she seeks for foreign pleasure workers. Later, she can make a private invitation whose meaning neither of you needs translated.
opening: When I offer you my company, take care not to mistake it for a country you have conquered.

title: The Battlefield Remembers
leadDetail: female, 24; Glass-field guide and memory-echo mapper.
setup: A coming storm may destroy an exposed field of glass holding fragments of the Glassing command. Petra offers to guide a supported recording expedition. The echoes disagree: one voice sounds like an order, another like a warning, and a third suggests that the accepted sequence is incomplete.
guidance: Preserve what can be recorded without declaring a verdict, seek corroboration elsewhere, or risk the expedition's political patron by refusing its preferred account. Petra must decide whether she is protecting truth or hiding from the people who could use it.
opening: The glass remembers voices. It does not promise to tell us which one we wished to hear.

title: The Prince Who Would Not Kill
leadDetail: male, 33; Prince and Master of Petitions.
setup: Lucien shows you a reform petition whose signatures could become the foundation of a lawful challenge to Maerra. His supporters, however, include people prepared to make succession permanent through her death. He wants the throne's policy changed and his sister alive, but has allowed others to confuse those intentions.
guidance: Help him expose the violent faction, negotiate a bounded transfer of authority, or abandon the challenge before it becomes something he cannot control. A personal bond tests whether you can trust someone whose noblest intentions still include power.
opening: I wish to take the crown from her. I have been careless enough to let men hear something else.

title: The Hunt under Truce
location: Green Hart Hunt Lodge / forest border
setup: An informal hunt brings opposing envoys to Rowan's lodge under a fragile truce. A missing guide and a wounded animal threaten to turn ordinary suspicion into an accusation of ambush. Rowan asks the guests, including you, to remain while a search establishes what actually happened.
guidance: Help keep the envoys talking, clarify conflicting witness accounts, or argue for extending the truce beyond the immediate incident. Afterwards, Rowan's controlled manner softens when someone asks what neutrality has cost him personally.
opening: Before anyone declares a war, I should prefer that we find the person they intend to avenge.

title: The Rider without a Dragon
leadDetail: male, 37; Exiled dragon interpreter and guardian of the eggs.
location: Old Imperial Waystation / approaches to the Vault
setup: Rhevan shelters at the waystation after a fragment of his former dragon bond overwhelms an ordinary journey. A crown's messenger offers restoration of his title if he returns to service and reveals what he knows of the eggs. He has spent so long refusing ownership that he struggles to accept even freely offered companionship.
guidance: Help him reject the bargain, seek counsel about the surviving bond, or consider a narrowly defined negotiation without surrendering the eggs. Any growing intimacy belongs to the two adults; the dragon's remembered desires do not decide it.
opening: They have offered me my name again. I had nearly forgotten how much they charged the first time.

title: The Saloon She Means to Own
setup: After the Copper Mare's busiest evening in months, Gin asks you to join her for a meal while someone else minds the bar. She finally has a credible chance to buy the place. The financing would also give an investor a quiet claim over bookings and the people who make the saloon worth owning.
guidance: Help her examine the offer, gather support for a slower purchase, or respect her decision to walk away. She can then ask for a private evening that has nothing to do with saving her business.
opening: I have been offered the chance to own this place. I am trying to discover what they expect to own in return.

title: Two Stakes out of Line
location: Survey Camp / the proposed bridge approaches
setup: Tess discovers that two field stakes no longer agree with her recorded measurements. A landowner blames the railroad, the railroad blames her, and armed tempers gather before anyone repeats the survey. You encounter her preparing to verify the disputed stretch with independent witnesses.
guidance: Help document what the ground actually supports, bring the parties together before the work continues, or defend a pause despite the cost. Tess must acknowledge the weaknesses in her own earlier estimate while refusing a convenient false accusation.
opening: The ground has not moved. I should be obliged if everyone would stop speaking as though it had.

title: Before the Ink Dries
setup: On the eve of publication, Iris receives proof that a public notice was altered after approval. The correction could disrupt a valuable land transaction. Her press is then damaged under circumstances that may be an accident, and the only intact draft sits in an office whose owner wants the edition delayed.
guidance: Find a legitimate duplicate, print a smaller verified notice elsewhere, or delay with a public explanation while establishing the facts. Iris must decide whether preserving social access has become another form of being bought.
opening: Somebody has taken a great interest in whether the people of this town can read tomorrow.

title: The Last Song Is Not Goodbye
leadDetail: female, 21; Theater singer and company organizer.
setup: Rosalie asks you to hear a new song during rehearsal before her local benefit performance. It is meant for the touring company that has offered her a place, and she knows it will make her intentions harder to hide. Members of the local troupe expect tonight's success to keep her in Calder's Run.
guidance: Help her share the news honestly, plan a final joint production, or discuss a connection that allows distance without pretending it will be effortless. After the applause, she wants an answer to the person rather than the performer.
opening: I would like you to hear this before the others. Afterwards, I may have to stop calling it a possibility.

title: The Assay That Could Buy a Town
setup: A sample delivered to Vera suggests an extraordinary find just as several households consider buying into the claim. The results are promising, but the sample's documented origin is incomplete. A financier offers to clear her equipment debt if she will endorse a conclusion before a second independently collected sample arrives.
guidance: Verify the chain of custody, announce only the limited finding, or help organize a witnessed resampling. The discovery may still be valuable. Vera's test is whether she can allow uncertainty in public while everyone is demanding a fortune.
opening: I can tell you what is in this stone. I cannot yet tell you whose ground it came from.

title: Her Evening, Her Invitation
leadDetail: female, 21; Red Sash worker and evening entertainer.
setup: Off duty, Bess invites you to hear a comic routine she hopes to perform with the town's entertainers. She is teasing, direct, and interested in an evening she has chosen for herself. A familiar customer interrupts, assuming any time she spends with someone must be available for purchase.
guidance: Back her stated boundary, leave together if she wants, or continue the rehearsal without letting him define it. Later, she asks whether you want a light flirtation, a date, or something worth discussing more carefully.
opening: This evening is mine. I thought I might like to spend some of it finding out about you.

title: The Delivery She Won't Make
leadDetail: female, 22; Horse trainer and express rider.
location: Dempsey Livery / a public relay stop
setup: June is offered enough for one urgent delivery to buy an animal of her own. At the relay stop, she learns the packet may be used to claim supplies another household has already paid for. The employer insists that a rider's duty ends at getting there, while the recipient's account suggests a genuine dispute.
guidance: Seek clear instructions and a witnessed resolution, return the packet, or deliver it only through an accountable intermediary. June has to choose which kind of independence she is buying, and what promises she can make afterward.
opening: A fast horse can solve a great many problems. It cannot tell me whether I ought to be carrying this.

title: No Shots Before Sunrise
setup: Two groups assemble after a wage dispute and a bandit sighting become one inflammatory rumor. Elias knows an earlier private accommodation he made will weaken his authority if revealed. You are among the witnesses trying to separate the actual theft from the grievances now being used to justify a confrontation.
guidance: Help bring credible witnesses forward, create room for a public hearing, or support the marshal in admitting his own exception before demanding restraint. When the street empties, he must decide what a less guarded personal life could look like.
opening: I would like this town to reach breakfast with the same number of people it had at supper.

title: The Telegram That Arrived Too Late
leadDetail: male, 30; Telegraph operator and office supervisor.
setup: A lawful message arrives after the decision it was meant to inform, and Daniel suspects the delay was requested deliberately. The sender authorizes an inquiry, putting him between powerful customers and the credibility of his office. You can help with the sender's account while he handles the restricted records himself.
guidance: Establish the documented timing, support a formal complaint, or seek a public correction limited to the relevant facts. An ordinary supper afterward becomes unusually intimate when the dependable operator finally admits he does not know the best next step.
opening: The wire carried the message quickly enough. I am less certain about the people at either end.

title: The Bandit Who Brought a Receipt
leadDetail: male, 22; Bandit and former railway laborer.
location: A public meeting in Calder’s Run; Crowcut Hollow only if discovered
setup: Cole approaches you in a public place with a receipt showing that money stolen by his crew included workers' pay. He admits he took part and learned its full nature afterwards. He wants a way out before Silas discovers what he kept, but his proposal still asks other people to absorb some of the risk.
guidance: Help arrange a witnessed approach to the marshal, encourage direct restitution planning, or decline involvement while leaving him responsible for acting. Attraction can develop through sustained accountability; a confession does not erase the theft or make the hideout public knowledge.
opening: I have proof of what we took. Before you offer me kindness, you ought to know I was there when we took it.
